description: Premium Startup Experience Redesign (Task 2): Replace the current OnboardingScreen with a 3-screen premium startup experience. Screen 1: Logo + 'Made for Art Lovers & Creators' + description + artwork background. Screen 2: 'Made in Nepal. Built for the World.' + large artwork. Screen 3: 'Grow Your Creative Business' + roles list + Get Started CTA + Continue as Guest + Google Login + Developer Login. Use official logo from assets. Dark premium background. Beautiful typography. Fade animations.
steps: STEP 1: Rewrite mobile/src/screens/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.tsx with 3 premium screens instead of the current 4 basic slides.

STEP 2: Screen 1 - Dark premium background (#0D0D0D or similar), display the official logo from '../../../assets/icon.png', title 'Made for Art Lovers & Creators', subtitle describing the platform, and a decorative artwork-style background element.

STEP 3: Screen 2 - 'Made in Nepal. Built for the World.' headline with a large artwork image placeholder (using the existing auth background media or a placeholder), emphasizing the Nepal origin story.

STEP 4: Screen 3 - 'Grow Your Creative Business' title, list of roles/features (Artist, Art Lover, Gallery, Business), a prominent 'Get Started' CTA button that completes onboarding, 'Continue as Guest' option that calls handleSkip (dispatch setGuest), Google Sign-In button that calls GoogleSignin.signIn(), and Developer Login button at the bottom.
STEP 5: Add fade-in/slide animations using React Native Animated API. Each screen should fade in content elegantly.

STEP 6: Preserve the existing interest selection functionality but move it to AFTER onboarding (or remove it since the new flow does not include it - the user spec does not mention interest selection in the new 3 screens).
STEP 7: Ensure the onboarding completion logic still works: dispatching setOnboardingComplete() and storing 'hasCompletedOnboarding' in SecureStore.
acceptance_criteria: OnboardingScreen has exactly 3 screens matching the described content
Screen 1 has logo, 'Made for Art Lovers & Creators', description, dark background
Screen 2 has 'Made in Nepal. Built for the World.' with large artwork display
Screen 3 has 'Grow Your Creative Business', roles list, Get Started button, Guest option, Google login, Dev login
Fade animations are present on screen transitions
Get Started button completes onboarding (sets SecureStore + dispatches action)
Google login on Screen 3 triggers GoogleSignin flow
verification: Read back the file and confirm it has valid TypeScript/JSX syntax
